meta.title: Digital Image Resolution Converter — Convert Dot/inch and More
meta.description: Free digital image resolution converter for 5+ units including Dot/inch, Dot/centimeter, Dot/millimeter. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: DPI, dot/cm, pixel/mm. Convert between 5 digital image resolution units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for digital image resolution in this tool is **dpi**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most digital image resolution conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.
content.conversion_table:
| Unit | Symbol |
| --- | --- |
| Dot/inch | dpi |
| Dot/centimeter | dpcm |
| Dot/millimeter | dpmm |
| Pixel/inch | ppi |
| Pixel/meter | ppm |
content.use_cases:
- Photography exposure planning across lumen and lux references.
- Workspace lighting design to meet ergonomic targets.
- Display brightness and ambient-light comparisons.
- Plant-grow lighting setups.
- Stage and event lighting design.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this digital image resolution converter?
**A:** It uses 5 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Dot/inch (dpi), Dot/centimeter (dpcm), Dot/millimeter (dpmm), Pixel/inch (ppi), Pixel/meter (ppm).
